notes: Nestari is a free AI room design tool for anyone who wants to see a new look before buying furniture or paint. Upload one photo of a living room, bedroom, or kitchen and Nestari keeps your walls, windows, doors, and camera angle while changing furniture, colors, flooring, lighting, and decor. Pick Modern, Minimalist, Scandinavian, Industrial, Japandi, or Bohemian and compare two designs side by side. Your first two designs need no account and no credit card; signing in with Google adds three more free, and credit packs start at $4.99 for 25 designs. Useful for homeowners, Airbnb hosts, and listing photos. Maker: Sky Bringup. Contact: hi@skybringup.com.
